# 5-Day Lisbon Trip Plan for 2 Adults

A relaxed Lisbon plan for **2025-09-10 to 2025-09-14** with **€1,800 total excluding flights**. It balances one museum day, one food-focused day, and one beach/scenic day while keeping transit light.

## Day-by-Day Lisbon Itinerary

### Day 1 — Sep 10: Baixa, Chiado, and Riverside Arrival
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/geo-alt.svg
- **Morning:** Arrive, check in, and do a slow walk through Baixa’s grid streets and Praça do Comércio.
- **Afternoon:** Ride the Santa Justa area, then wander Chiado for cafés, tiles, and bookstores.
- **Evening:** Sunset along the Ribeira das Naus promenade with an easy riverside dinner.
- **Food:** Try a classic bacalhau dish or a simple petiscos spread.

### Day 2 — Sep 11: Alfama and Museum Day
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/building.svg
- **Morning:** Start in Alfama with a calm walk to the Lisbon Cathedral and nearby viewpoints.
- **Afternoon:** Visit one major museum, then linger over coffee rather than stacking more sights.
- **Evening:** Stay in the old town for fado or a quiet dinner in a small tavern.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/4c/Lisbon_%281600%29_detail_1.jpg Alt=Evening:** Stay in the old town for fado or a quiet dinner in a small tavern, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Food:** Pastéis de nata and a seafood lunch fit well here.

### Day 3 — Sep 12: Food-Focused Day in Mercado, Time Out, and Neighborhood Taverns
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/cup-hot.svg
- **Morning:** Late start, then brunch in the city center or near Cais do Sodré.
- **Afternoon:** Sample multiple stalls at Time Out Market and nearby tasting spots.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/8/83/Lobster%2C_Time_Out_Market_Lisboa_%2850661858143%29.jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Sample multiple stalls at Time Out Market and nearby tasting spots, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Evening:** Book a relaxed dinner in Bairro Alto or Príncipe Real.
- **Food:** Build the day around cod croquettes, grilled sardines, oysters, and desserts.

### Day 4 — Sep 13: Scenic Day in Belém and the Riverfront
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Morning:** Head to Belém for the Jerónimos area, tower views, and long river walks.
- **Afternoon:** Slow lunch, then continue along the waterfront or relax in a garden.
- **Evening:** Return to central Lisbon for an easy dinner and an early night.
- **Food:** Pastéis de Belém are the obvious stop, plus a light lunch near the river.

### Day 5 — Sep 14: Beach or Coastal Escape
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- **Morning:** Take a half-day trip to Cascais or Carcavelos for sea air and a relaxed pace.
- **Afternoon:** Beach time, coastal walking, and a long late lunch.
Media: Image=https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/3/3c/Beach_near_Lisbon_Portugal%2C_1994..jpg Alt=Afternoon:** Beach time, coastal walking, and a long late lunch, Lisbon, Portugal
- **Evening:** Back to Lisbon for packing and one final neighborhood dinner.
- **Food:** Seafood rice, grilled fish, or a casual beachside lunch.

## Area-Based Activity Map

### Central Lisbon Core
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/map.svg
- **Baixa:** Arrival walk, Praça do Comércio, easy shopping streets
- **Chiado:** Cafés, bookstores, relaxed browsing
- **Cais do Sodré:** Riverside dinners, market access, nightlife

### Historic Hills
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/signpost-split.svg
- **Alfama:** Cathedral, viewpoints, narrow lanes
- **Mouraria:** Local food stops and quieter streets
- **Castelo area:** Scenic overlook option if energy is high

### Riverfront and Western Lisbon
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/water.svg
- **Belém:** Monuments, museum time, pastry stop
- **Ajuda/river edge:** Slower scenic walking and gardens
- **LX Factory area:** Optional creative stop on a spare afternoon

### Coastal Day Trip Zone
Media: Icon=https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/bootstrap-icons@1.11.3/icons/sun.svg
- **Cascais:** Best for a full scenic beach day
- **Carcavelos:** Easier beach option with less transit
- **Estoril:** Calm promenade and relaxed cafés

## Budget Breakdown for 2 Adults

| Category | Planned Spend | Notes |
|---|---:|---|
| Accommodation | €700 | Comfortable mid-range stay, 4 nights |
| Food & drinks | €520 | Mix of cafés, market meals, and 2 nicer dinners |
| Local transport | €80 | Metro, trams, occasional taxi/rideshare |
| Museums & entry fees | €120 | One main museum plus a few small entries |
| Day trip / beach costs | €90 | Train/bus, beach extras, light snacks |
| Buffer / extras | €290 | Souvenirs, coffee, flexibility, small surprises |
| Total | **€1,800** | Fits the target budget |
